REQ-FUNC-039.rationale: Gives operators a way to keep larger scenes together when the configured model context window can support wider prompt windows.
REQ-FUNC-039.requirement: AI Chunking Service shall apply the selected chunking context mode when building AI prompt windows: Balanced keeps the current paragraph, meaning, and scene caps at 64, 96, and 128 paragraphs; Wide scene context uses 128, 192, and 256 paragraph caps; Maximum context disables the paragraph cap and relies only on the token budget.

REQ-FUNC-040.rationale: Prevents local or online models from rewriting audiobook text while preserving speaker attribution and downstream Speech Blocks review/export fields.
REQ-FUNC-040.requirement: Speech Blocks Service shall normalize narrator-and-character model responses through the single span-selection contract where model-selected source span IDs, speaker IDs, content kind, confidence, and warnings are validated before persisted `source_text` and `text` are reconstructed only from the source chunk.

REQ-FUNC-041.rationale: Avoids mixing AI-owned legacy block text with the new deterministic source-span contract.
REQ-FUNC-041.requirement: Speech Blocks Service shall treat incompatible partial narrator-and-character Speech Blocks generation state from the previous implementation as non-resumable and start fresh generation while preserving the existing same-narrator boundary-ID resume behavior.

REQ-FUNC-042.rationale: Gives local and online models a bounded selection vocabulary while keeping persisted Speech Blocks text reconstructable from app-owned source text.
REQ-FUNC-042.requirement: Speech Blocks Service shall build and attach deterministic `source_spans` with stable ordered IDs to every narrator-and-character source chunk or AI-budget segment before the model call, and those spans shall contiguously reconstruct the exact active text including whitespace, punctuation, and paragraph order without merging across paragraph boundaries.

REQ-FUNC-043.rationale: Improves local-model speaker and block attribution hints for multilingual books without translating or rewriting source text.
REQ-FUNC-043.requirement: Speech Blocks source-span builder shall classify spans as `dialogue_candidate`, `narration_candidate`, `attribution_candidate`, or `mixed_candidate` using Unicode dialogue punctuation and paragraph structure rather than English-only speech verbs across supported languages including Romanian.

REQ-FUNC-044.rationale: Gives LM Studio and other local providers a stricter response envelope than a generic JSON object while keeping the app-owned source-span contract single-versioned.
REQ-FUNC-044.requirement: Speech Blocks generation shall request the narrator-and-character source-span selection contract with an operation-specific structured-output schema hint whenever the selected AI profile supports structured output.

REQ-FUNC-045.rationale: Makes local-model output recoverable without trusting the first response or requiring a second full prompt containing the book text.
REQ-FUNC-045.requirement: Speech Blocks generation shall retry exactly once with a compact repair prompt when the initial narrator-and-character source-span response is malformed JSON or semantically invalid, including missing confidence, illegal span IDs, hallucinated halo span IDs, unknown speakers, duplicate spans, out-of-order spans, or incomplete coverage.

REQ-FUNC-046.rationale: Keeps Speech Blocks review usable after local-model failure and avoids corrupting downstream audio generation with rewritten or reordered text.
REQ-FUNC-046.requirement: When both the initial and repair source-span responses are unusable, Speech Blocks generation shall create deterministic fallback blocks in source order using safe narrator defaults and warning metadata while preserving exact source text reconstruction.

REQ-FUNC-047.rationale: Keeps local and online models constrained to app-owned source reconstruction across supported languages including Romanian.
REQ-FUNC-047.requirement: Narrator-and-character Speech Blocks prompts shall use the multilingual source-span selection contract only, include the active source language, prohibit translation or rewritten final text, require allowed `source_span_ids` only, and return JSON-only `blocks`.
REQ-FUNC-047.verification: Automated pytest verifies multilingual source-span Speech Blocks prompt contract.

REQ-FUNC-048.rationale: Improves speaker attribution for multilingual local models while preventing halo text from being selected into saved Speech Blocks.
REQ-FUNC-048.requirement: Speech Blocks prompt rendering shall expose source-language character names and aliases in the allowed speaker catalog and include previous/next chunk halo text only as non-selectable attribution context, never as selectable source spans.
REQ-FUNC-048.verification: Automated pytest verifies character aliases and source-language evidence are present in Speech Blocks prompt catalogs.

REQ-FUNC-049.rationale: Speech Blocks quality depends on upstream operations preserving the text structure that span selection and speaker attribution consume.
REQ-FUNC-049.requirement: Adjacent text cleanup, translation, and chunking prompt guidance shall preserve multilingual dialogue punctuation, paragraph shape, and nearby attribution needed by Speech Blocks source-span selection.
REQ-FUNC-049.verification: Automated pytest verifies adjacent cleanup, translation, and chunking prompts preserve dialogue punctuation and attribution context for Speech Blocks.

REQ-FUNC-050.rationale: A model-selectable source span can contain several audiobook blocks, so structural splitting must happen before speaker assignment.
REQ-FUNC-050.requirement: Speech Blocks Service shall derive narrator-and-character Speech Blocks from deterministic atomic speech units, allowing one source span to produce multiple ordered units while preserving exact source text coverage.
REQ-FUNC-050.verification: Automated pytest via uv run --project 04_Software/AudioMancer pytest -q 04_Software/AudioMancer/tests/test_speech_blocks_text_split_service.py

REQ-FUNC-051.rationale: Books can use different punctuation and lexical forms, but attribution text must remain separate from spoken dialogue for audiobook generation.
REQ-FUNC-051.requirement: Speech Blocks atomic unit splitting shall classify multilingual quoted dialogue, dash-led dialogue, attribution narration, ordinary narration, and separators using Unicode dialogue punctuation and source-language attribution patterns including Romanian.
REQ-FUNC-051.verification: Automated pytest via uv run --project 04_Software/AudioMancer pytest -q 04_Software/AudioMancer/tests/test_speech_blocks_text_split_service.py

REQ-FUNC-052.rationale: Local models should help decide who speaks without being able to corrupt block boundaries or source wording.
REQ-FUNC-052.requirement: Speech Blocks AI generation shall ask models to assign speakers to existing atomic unit IDs only, using allowed speaker IDs, confidence, and warning flags, while validation rejects skipped, duplicated, reordered, merged, rewritten, or structurally inconsistent units.
REQ-FUNC-052.verification: Automated pytest via uv run --project 04_Software/AudioMancer pytest -q 04_Software/AudioMancer/tests/test_speech_blocks_service.py

REQ-FUNC-053.rationale: Character attribution quality depends on source-language evidence and deterministic hints, especially for local models and role speakers.
REQ-FUNC-053.requirement: Speech Blocks speaker detection shall use source-language character aliases, role labels, nearby attribution hints, same-speaker continuations, and ambiguity warnings before falling back to narrator defaults.
REQ-FUNC-053.verification: Automated pytest via uv run --project 04_Software/AudioMancer pytest -q 04_Software/AudioMancer/tests/test_speech_blocks_service.py

REQ-FUNC-054.rationale: Newline and paragraph separator units preserve source offsets but are not audiobook content and should not burden local models or reviewers with empty rows.
REQ-FUNC-054.requirement: Speech Blocks atomic-unit prompting and validation shall treat separator-only or whitespace-only atomic units as non-speakable provenance so they cannot create standalone persisted Narrator or dialogue blocks with empty text, while still requiring coverage of all selectable speakable units.
REQ-FUNC-054.verification: Automated pytest via uv run --project 04_Software/AudioMancer pytest -q 04_Software/AudioMancer/tests/test_speech_blocks_service.py

REQ-FUNC-055.rationale: Narrator-only mode still generates spoken review blocks, so splitting inside quoted speech makes text look corrupted even when no source text was deleted.
REQ-FUNC-055.requirement: Same-narrator Speech Blocks boundary selection shall avoid normal split candidates inside open quoted passages and shall reject or warning-mark any selected boundary set that would persist blocks with unmatched opening or closing quotation marks.
REQ-FUNC-055.verification: E-0045 and E-0046 prove quote-safe same-narrator boundary behavior; E-0047 and E-0048 prove focused Speech Blocks regressions remain green.

REQ-TEST-002.requirement: Python implementation changes shall be validated with `python -m py_compile` for each changed Python file.
REQ-TEST-002.verification: Manual verification: final summary names compiled files, or states that no Python files changed.

REQ-TEST-003.rationale: Keeps code style consistent without broad unrelated churn.
REQ-TEST-003.requirement: Python changes inside `04_Software/AudioMancer/` shall run changed-file Ruff check and format commands.
REQ-TEST-003.verification: Manual verification: final summary names Ruff commands, or states that no Python files changed.

REQ-TEST-004.requirement: Behavior changes shall add or update focused automated tests and state the validation performed and remaining gaps.

REQ-TEST-005.rationale: Stable records let future changes update requirements without losing history.
REQ-TEST-005.requirement: Requirement changes shall preserve stable IDs, timestamps, status values, priority values, and linked automated or manual verification methods.

REQ-TEST-006.rationale: Regression protection depends on register-to-test links staying valid; renamed or deleted tests must not silently orphan a requirement.
REQ-TEST-006.requirement: Every `Linked Tests` node ID recorded in the requirement registers shall resolve to a real test, and every Active requirement shall name a resolvable automated test or an explicit manual verification method.

REQ-TEST-007.rationale: Prevents untested logic modules from being added without regression coverage as the application grows.
REQ-TEST-007.requirement: Every module under `src/audiomancer/services/` and `src/audiomancer/ui/controllers/` shall be covered by at least one linked automated test or carry a recorded coverage waiver.

REQ-TEST-008.rationale: Per-change focused tests do not guarantee the whole suite is green at delivery time; a full-suite gate prevents shipping cross-cutting regressions.
REQ-TEST-008.requirement: A clean full `uv run pytest` run shall be a precondition for any release or delivery publish.

REQ-TEST-009.rationale: Keeps component documentation from drifting during normal feature work without forcing unrelated README or validation-document churn.

REQ-UX-032.rationale: Keeps workflow page selection one click away in a familiar left sidebar while compact status panes leave the maximum window space to the review panes; page layouts use stretch factors and dynamic splitter minimums so content scales proportionally to the remaining width.
REQ-UX-032.requirement: The main-window workflow navigation shall render as a fixed-width (160 px) vertical sidebar list placed left of the page stack, with the page stack occupying the remaining window width; workflow pages shall maximize their text and list editors by keeping the bottom operator-status pane as an undecorated, flush container (no group-box title or frame and zero internal margins) sized to a compact font-aware three-row height.

REQ-UX-033.rationale: Preserves a compact, scannable Speech Blocks workflow header without hidden generation controls or overlapping profile selection.
REQ-UX-033.requirement: The Speech Blocks page header shall render the page title, AI profile label, AI profile selector, Generate All, Reset, and Approve All controls on one horizontal row at default startup with the default font size, keeping all labels visible and preventing control overlap.

REQ-UX-034.rationale: Lets operators tune AI chunking prompt breadth from the existing settings workflow without editing project files.
REQ-UX-034.requirement: AI Settings Page shall expose a localized Chunking Context Mode selector with exactly Balanced, Wide scene context, and Maximum context options, defaulting to Balanced for missing or invalid settings and persisting the selected mode through Save, OK, and Apply flows.
